messages:
anya: Heads-up — we're seeing customer reports that fncall validation errors are getting billed to the wrong route (shows up as /invoke-main in the console). Pls eyeball.

sam: ugh. can you paste an example request id or logs?

anya: req id 9c3f2a11, timestamp 2025-11-04T14:12:23Z. user says they hit a schema rejection from our validator and the console shows ~120 tokens billed on /invoke-main instead of /fncall. not huge but reproducible across two customers. :thinking_face:

jordan: quick theory: validation happens in the orchestrator before we attach route metadata, so billing tag is defaulting. we used to forward route tag earlier but a refactor moved it.

maria: repro snippet below — this is how our client calls the action (ts shortened):
```json
POST /v1/chat/completions
{ "model": "rwd-chat-1", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"call tool"}], "functions": [{"name":"math","schema":{...}}] }
```
and server-side we return: `{"error":"invalid_function_output","details":"expected object got array"}`

sam: can we confirm where billing label is injected? router or edge?

jordan: label is currently set in the route-resolver step which runs after validation in the new pipeline. should be swapped so route-resolver runs first or we copy route tag earlier.

anya: any quick mitigation we can roll to reduce misbilling while we debate? Customers noticing spike in fncall rejects and raising support tickets.

maria: we could add a cheap shim: if response has `error` with `invalid_function_output` tag, set route to `/fncall` before emitting billing event. minimal change.

sam: sounds fine as short-term. Need to add tests and backfill a few hours of telemetry labels for impacted reqs. who owns?

jordan: i'll own the shim PR and unit tests. i'll also add a small sampling tag so we can detect any false-positives.

anya: ops ask: can SRE/observability backfill the console so existing traces show fncall instead of invoke? we need to fix billing attribution for yesterday's window.

devex-bot: @observability FYI — rollout note: any server-side shim must be behind a feature-flag for canary (10% first). We'll push canary to dedicated and hosted.

sam: backfill plan: replay logs for 2025-11-03 00:00-06:00 UTC, patch labels where validation error matched the predicate. Ops: can you run a dry-run count?

maria: i ran a local replay against a snapshot — about 214 events would be relabeled. not massive but across customers it matters.

jordan: PR draft ready, adding unit for the `invalid_function_output` enum and e2e that asserts billing tag is `/fncall` for that path. Will include migration script stub for ops.

anya: perfect. once jordan sends the PR i'll add the support note and temporary dashboard alert to catch any remaining mislabels. :thumbsup:
